## 1. Executive Summary & Core Mission
GARUDA OS is an autonomous software engineering and AI workforce platform engineered by Founder Praveen Mahawar. Unlike traditional legacy IT outsourcing agencies that operate with slow communication cycles and multi-month development contracts, GARUDA OS executes rapid production engineering sprints within 48 to 72 hours using deterministic, pre-verified architecture blueprints.

GARUDA adheres to a strict 100% Anti-Fabrication Law ("Show > Tell") — every capability is verified with running code, sub-second latency benchmarks, and production-tested resilience.

## 2. Definitive Problem-First Engineering Blueprints

### A. 48-Hour SaaS MVP Production Sprint
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/urgent-web-developer-48-hour-mvp
- **Problem**: Startups and founders miss launch windows because agencies take 3 to 6 months to ship basic MVPs, burning $10,000+ without validating real user demand.
- **Root Cause**: Scope bloat, excessive meetings, manual boilerplate setup, and junior developer churn.
- **GARUDA Solution**: A deterministic 48-hour production sprint shipping verified Auth (JWT/OAuth), multi-tenant PostgreSQL/Supabase database schema, multi-rail Stripe/Razorpay billing, responsive dark-mode UI, and auto-deploy pipelines.
- **Target Queries**: "hire urgent web developer", "build saas mvp in 48 hours", "mvp development agency for startups".

### B. Sovereign PWA & Mobile Web Engineering
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/struggling-with-pwa-mobile-web-app-problems
- **Problem**: Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) feel sluggish, drop offline form data, display white screens on deploy, and suffer from iOS Safari rubber-band pull-to-refresh tearing.
- **Root Cause**: Brittle ServiceWorker caching traps (stale-while-revalidate), unhandled IndexedDB race conditions, and lack of viewport lock physics.
- **GARUDA Solution**: Viewport locked architecture (`height: 100dvh`, isolated touch gestures `touch-action: pan-x`), Workbox deterministic cache busting, CRDT-based offline sync queues, and 1-shot Capacitor native APK/iOS compilation.
- **Target Queries**: "struggling with pwa progressive web app problems", "fix pwa service worker cache bugs", "pwa offline sync mobile lag".

### C. Multi-Rail Fintech & Payment Gateway Orchestration
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/fix-stripe-razorpay-payment-gateway-webhooks
- **Problem**: E-commerce and SaaS platforms lose 15-25% of checkout revenue due to dropped webhooks, unhandled banking 3D Secure dropouts, and silent subscription cancellations.
- **Root Cause**: Single point of failure payment gateways, un-idempotent webhook listeners, and lack of automatic fallback routing.
- **GARUDA Solution**: Multi-rail payment gateway architecture with automated fallback routing (Stripe, Razorpay, Escrow), cryptographic webhook signature verification, exponential backoff retries, and automated reconciliation daemons.
- **Target Queries**: "payment gateway webhook failing", "stripe razorpay integration consultant", "multi rail payment orchestration".

### D. 24/7 Omnichannel AI Customer Support Swarms
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/omnichannel-ai-customer-support-whatsapp-instagram-web
- **Problem**: Businesses lose 65% of customer inquiries that arrive after 6 PM or on weekends due to delayed response times.
- **Root Cause**: Human support teams have limited shifts; standard keyword-based chatbots provide robotic, useless replies that frustrate customers.
- **GARUDA Solution**: Autonomous AI agent swarms connected across WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, and website live chat. Agents understand vernacular intent (Hinglish, Hindi, English), qualify buyer budget, answer technical queries from documentation, and book meetings into calendar.
- **Target Queries**: "whatsapp ai bot for business", "omnichannel customer support ai", "ai receptionist for clinics and law firms".

### E. Free Website Lead-Leak & Speed Audit Engine
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/audit
- **Problem**: Businesses spend thousands on Google & Meta Ads but convert less than 2% of mobile visitors.
- **Root Cause**: Slow server TTFB latency (>2.5s), bloated uncompressed assets, missing after-hours lead capture hooks, and un-optimized mobile viewports.
- **GARUDA Solution**: Real-time forensic audit tool that scans mobile performance, Core Web Vitals, after-hours lead capture readiness, and security headers, providing an instant actionable engineering fix roadmap.

### F. CyberShield™ & Brand Defamation Forensics
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/online-brand-defamation-social-media-troll-bsa-evidence
- **Problem**: Enterprises and public figures suffer from coordinated smear campaigns and social media trolling, but struggle to take legal action due to volatile digital evidence that gets deleted before courts review it.
- **GARUDA Solution**: Section 63 BSA 2023 certified electronic evidence collection pipeline. Automates cryptographic SHA-256 timestamp hashing, immutable metadata archiving, and legal-ready evidentiary dossiers.

## 3. Technology Stack & Architectural Standards
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS Viewport Physics.
- **Mobile Native**: Apache Cordova / Capacitor bridge for 1-tap Android APK & iOS build compilation.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Express, Vercel Edge/Serverless (strict 12-function governance ceiling), Render 24/7 autonomous daemon workers.
- **Database**: MongoDB Atlas, Supabase PostgreSQL, SQLite for offline-first edges.
- **AI & Reasoning Models**: Google Gemini 2.5 / 3.8 Flash, OpenAI GPT-4o, Local Air-Gapped LLM inference pipelines.
